sampling.lookup: nearest/containing overview pixel of each source
sampling.land: WorldCover class not in {0 nodata/absent tile, 80 permanent water}
sampling.elevation: DEM value > -1000 m; DSM (includes canopy/buildings); land samples without DEM value excluded from mean/p50 and counted as not above thresholds
sampling.p50: median from 10 m histogram (bin centre), range -500..6000 m
sampling.fractions: relative to land_samples; empty when land_samples=0
caveats: Copernicus DEM is pixel-is-point; overview pixel treated as area cell (offset <= ~0.5 native pixel, ~45 m), negligible at 25 km
WorldCover overview resampling method is not stated in the COG; categorical fractions at 1/375 deg are an overview estimate, not 10 m statistics
DEM overview (factor 4, average) smooths peaks: high-threshold fractions slightly underestimate small summits
